queries.sql:
SELECT l_returnflag, l_linestatus,
    CAST(SUM(l_quantity) * 100 AS BIGINT) AS sum_quantity,
    CAST(SUM(l_extendedprice) * 100 AS BIGINT) AS sum_price, COUNT(*) AS count_order
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT l_orderkey, l_linenumber, l_returnflag, l_linestatus,
    l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_shipdate FROM lineitem
    WHERE l_shipdate <= DATE '1998-09-02') AS matches
GROUP BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus

SELECT DISTINCT CAST(s.s_acctbal * 100 AS BIGINT),
    s.s_name, n.n_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_mfgr, s.s_address, s.s_phone, s.s_comment
FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
WHERE p.p_size = 15 AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS' AND r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
AND ps.ps_supplycost = (
    SELECT MIN(ps2.ps_supplycost) FROM partsupp ps2
    JOIN supplier s2 ON s2.s_suppkey = ps2.ps_suppkey
    JOIN nation n2 ON n2.n_nationkey = s2.s_nationkey
    JOIN region r2 ON r2.r_regionkey = n2.n_regionkey
    WHERE ps2.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey AND r2.r_name = 'EUROPE')

WITH matches AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost
    FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
    JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE n.n_name = 'GERMANY')
SELECT ps_partkey, CAST(SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) * 100 AS BIGINT)
FROM matches GROUP BY ps_partkey
HAVING SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) >
    (SELECT SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) * 0.0001 FROM matches)

WITH revenue AS (
    SELECT l_suppkey AS supplier_key,
        CAST(SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) * 10000 AS BIGINT) AS total_revenue
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT l_orderkey, l_linenumber, l_suppkey,
        l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_shipdate FROM lineitem
        WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1996-04-01') matches
    GROUP BY l_suppkey)
SELECT DISTINCT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_address, s.s_phone, r.total_revenue
FROM supplier s JOIN revenue r ON s.s_suppkey = r.supplier_key
WHERE r.total_revenue = (SELECT MAX(total_revenue) FROM revenue)

SELECT DISTINCT s.s_name, s.s_address
FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
WHERE n.n_name = 'CANADA' AND s.s_suppkey IN (
    SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps
    WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_name LIKE 'forest%')
    AND ps.ps_availqty > 0.5 * (
        SELECT SUM(l.l_quantity) FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT l_orderkey, l_linenumber, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_quantity, l_shipdate
            FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1994-01-01'
                AND l_shipdate < DATE '1995-01-01') l
        WHERE l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey))

SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(l_extendedprice * l_discount), 0) * 10000 AS BIGINT) AS revenue
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT l_orderkey, l_linenumber, l_extendedprice, l_discount,
    l_quantity, l_shipdate FROM lineitem
    WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1995-01-01'
      AND l_discount BETWEEN 0.05 AND 0.07 AND l_quantity < 24) AS matches

SELECT c_custkey, c_name,
    CAST(SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) * 10000 AS BIGINT) AS revenue,
    CAST(c_acctbal * 100 AS BIGINT) AS account_balance, n_name, c_address, c_phone, c_comment
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, c.c_nationkey,
    c.c_address, c.c_phone, c.c_comment, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate,
    l.l_linenumber, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, l.l_returnflag, n.n_name
    FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
    JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
    JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
    WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1994-01-01'
      AND l.l_returnflag = 'R') AS matches
GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name, c_acctbal, n_name, c_address, c_phone, c_comment

SELECT l_shipmode,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BIGINT) AS high_line_count,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o_orderpriority NOT IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BIGINT) AS low_line_count
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT l.l_orderkey, l.l_linenumber, l.l_shipmode, l.l_commitdate,
    l.l_receiptdate, l.l_shipdate, o.o_orderpriority
    FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
    WHERE l.l_shipmode IN ('MAIL', 'SHIP') AND l.l_commitdate < l.l_receiptdate
      AND l.l_shipdate < l.l_commitdate AND l.l_receiptdate >= DATE '1994-01-01'
      AND l.l_receiptdate < DATE '1995-01-01') AS matches
GROUP BY l_shipmode

SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey)
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT c_custkey FROM customer) c
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT o_orderkey, o_custkey FROM orders
    WHERE o_comment NOT LIKE '%special%requests%') o ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
GROUP BY c.c_custkey

SELECT
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p_type LIKE 'PROMO%' THEN
        l_extendedprice * (1.00 - l_discount) ELSE 0 END), 0) * 10000 AS BIGINT) AS promo_revenue,
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(l_extendedprice * (1.00 - l_discount)), 0) * 10000 AS BIGINT) AS total_revenue
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT l.l_orderkey, l.l_linenumber, l.l_partkey,
    l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, l.l_shipdate, p.p_type
    FROM lineitem l JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
    WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-09-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1995-10-01') AS matches

WITH quantities AS (
    SELECT l_orderkey, CAST(SUM(l_quantity) * 100 AS BIGINT) AS sum_quantity
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT l_orderkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity FROM lineitem) AS lines
    GROUP BY l_orderkey HAVING SUM(l_quantity) > 300.00
)
SELECT DISTINCT c.c_name, c.c_custkey, o.o_orderkey,
    (o.o_orderdate - DATE '1970-01-01')::INTEGER AS o_orderdate,
    CAST(o.o_totalprice * 100 AS BIGINT) AS total_price, q.sum_quantity
FROM quantities q JOIN orders o ON q.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey

SELECT
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(l_extendedprice * (1.00 - l_discount)), 0) * 10000 AS BIGINT) AS revenue
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT l.l_orderkey, l.l_linenumber, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity,
    l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, l.l_shipmode, l.l_shipinstruct,
    p.p_brand, p.p_container, p.p_size
    FROM lineitem l JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
    WHERE l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'AIR REG') AND l.l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'
    AND ((p.p_brand = 'Brand#12' AND p.p_container IN ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK', 'SM PKG')
            AND l.l_quantity BETWEEN 1.00 AND 11.00 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 5)
        OR (p.p_brand = 'Brand#23' AND p.p_container IN ('MED BAG', 'MED BOX', 'MED PKG', 'MED PACK')
            AND l.l_quantity BETWEEN 10.00 AND 20.00 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 10)
        OR (p.p_brand = 'Brand#34' AND p.p_container IN ('LG CASE', 'LG BOX', 'LG PACK', 'LG PKG')
            AND l.l_quantity BETWEEN 20.00 AND 30.00 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 15))) AS matches

SELECT DISTINCT o.o_orderkey
FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1993-07-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1993-10-01'
AND l.l_commitdate < l.l_receiptdate

SELECT DISTINCT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o
WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1993-07-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1993-10-01'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
AND l.l_commitdate < l.l_receiptdate)

SELECT DISTINCT p.p_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey
FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
WHERE p.p_brand <> 'Brand#45' AND p.p_type NOT LIKE 'MEDIUM POLISHED%'
AND p.p_size IN (49, 14, 23, 45, 19, 3, 36, 9)
AND ps.ps_suppkey NOT IN (SELECT s.s_suppkey FROM supplier s
WHERE s.s_comment LIKE '%Customer%Complaints%')

SELECT DISTINCT c.c_custkey FROM customer c
WHERE substring(c.c_phone FROM 1 FOR 2) IN ('13', '31', '23', '29', '30', '18', '17')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey)

SELECT DISTINCT o.o_orderkey, c.c_custkey
FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-03-15'
AND l.l_shipdate > DATE '1995-03-15'

SELECT DISTINCT o.o_orderkey, s.s_suppkey, n.n_nationkey
FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey AND s.s_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA' AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-01-01'
AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-01-01'

SELECT DISTINCT o.o_orderkey, ns.n_nationkey, nc.n_nationkey
FROM supplier s JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
JOIN nation ns ON s.s_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey
JOIN nation nc ON c.c_nationkey = nc.n_nationkey
WHERE ((ns.n_name = 'FRANCE' AND nc.n_name = 'GERMANY')
OR (ns.n_name = 'GERMANY' AND nc.n_name = 'FRANCE'))
AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate <= DATE '1996-12-31'

SELECT DISTINCT o.o_orderkey, ns.n_nationkey, nc.n_nationkey
FROM supplier s JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
JOIN nation ns ON s.s_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey
JOIN nation nc ON c.c_nationkey = nc.n_nationkey
WHERE ((ns.n_name = 'FRANCE' AND nc.n_name = 'GERMANY')
OR (ns.n_name = 'GERMANY' AND nc.n_name = 'FRANCE'))
AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate <= DATE '1996-12-31'

SELECT DISTINCT o.o_orderkey, p.p_partkey, s.s_suppkey
FROM lineitem l JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation nc ON c.c_nationkey = nc.n_nationkey
JOIN region r ON nc.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
JOIN nation ns ON s.s_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey
WHERE r.r_name = 'AMERICA' AND p.p_type = 'ECONOMY ANODIZED STEEL'
AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= DATE '1996-12-31'

SELECT DISTINCT o.o_orderkey, p.p_partkey, s.s_suppkey
FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey
JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
WHERE p.p_name LIKE '%green%'

SELECT DISTINCT l1.l_orderkey, s.s_suppkey, l2.l_suppkey
FROM supplier s JOIN lineitem l1 ON s.s_suppkey = l1.l_suppkey
JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = l1.l_orderkey
JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
JOIN lineitem l2 ON l1.l_orderkey = l2.l_orderkey
WHERE n.n_name = 'SAUDI ARABIA' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F'
AND l1.l_receiptdate > l1.l_commitdate AND l2.l_suppkey <> l1.l_suppkey

SELECT DISTINCT o.o_orderkey, p.p_partkey, c.c_custkey, s.s_suppkey
FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-04-01'
AND n.n_name = 'UNITED STATES'

SELECT DISTINCT o.o_orderkey, p.p_partkey, s.s_suppkey
FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-04-01'
AND p.p_brand = 'Brand#12' AND n.n_name = 'UNITED STATES'

SELECT DISTINCT o.o_orderkey, p.p_partkey, s.s_suppkey, n.n_nationkey
FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey AND c.c_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1995-04-01'
AND l.l_quantity > 20.00 AND ps.ps_availqty > 0

SELECT DISTINCT o.o_orderkey, p.p_partkey, ns.n_nationkey
FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey
JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN nation nc ON nc.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
JOIN nation ns ON ns.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-04-01'
AND nc.n_name = 'UNITED STATES' AND ps.ps_availqty > 0

WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1994-01-01'
  AND l_shipdate < DATE '1995-01-01'

SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM lineitem, part
WHERE p_partkey = l_partkey
  AND l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'AIR REG')
  AND l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'
  AND (
    (p_brand = 'Brand#12'
      AND p_container IN ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK', 'SM PKG')
      AND l_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 11 AND p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 5)
    OR
    (p_brand = 'Brand#23'
      AND p_container IN ('MED BAG', 'MED BOX', 'MED PKG', 'MED PACK')
      AND l_quantity BETWEEN 10 AND 20 AND p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 10)
    OR
    (p_brand = 'Brand#34'
      AND p_container IN ('LG CASE', 'LG BOX', 'LG PACK', 'LG PKG')
      AND l_quantity BETWEEN 20 AND 30 AND p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 15)
  );
